name: Tinyfolk: Pocket Hologram
subtitle: Tiny 3D friends that see you
promo: A tiny friend stands on the fold of your iPhone Duo and looks right at you. Move your head and the little world moves like it's really there.
description:
Tinyfolk turns your iPhone into a pocket hologram: a tiny 3D friend that stands in front of you, follows your eyes and waves hello.

STANDS ON THE FOLD OF iPHONE DUO
Stand iPhone Duo half open, like a tiny laptop. The upper half becomes a back wall, the lower half a floor, and your friend stands right on the fold. Tinyfolk follows where your eyes are with the front camera and draws both halves from exactly your point of view, using the live hinge angle, so the floor looks flat and the character looks solid from every side. Move your head and look around them.

OPEN IT FLAT FOR A SURPRISE
Open iPhone Duo all the way and the floor gives way. Your friend tumbles into a lantern well beneath the glass. Paper lanterns float up and knock against the glass from below, and you feel every knock.

IT NOTICES BOTH OF YOU
Show a friend: the character looks at whoever is looking, turns between you, and waves when someone new walks up.

EIGHT ORIGINAL FRIENDS, SIX STAGES
Pim the ceramic robot, Juni the fox, Mossy the leaf sprite and Odette the wooden dancer are free. Each has their own little dance. Pick a Holo Studio with a glowing ring, a Paper Garden or a Night Rooftop strung with lights.

MUSIC PLAYED LIVE
Gentle instrumental pieces played by a small synthesizer on your device, from an original waltz to the traditional Üsküdar'a Gider İken. The cast dances on the beat.

WORKS ON EVERY iPHONE AND iPAD
Without a fold, the screen becomes a window into a little diorama box. Lay it flat to look down into the well.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Camera frames are analysed on your device and dropped at once. Nothing is recorded, stored or sent. No account, no ads, no tracking. Head tracking is optional; tilting the phone also gives depth.

TINYFOLK PRO
One payment, shared with your family: four more friends (Cosmo, Tuck, Kumo, Lumen), three more stages, four more pieces of music and screen recording. Everything free stays free forever.
